_doc: Reachability notes on live Atlas cards: stale (marked live, own content did not come back) and challenge_walled (up, but plain scripts get a challenge page).

Rules and field meanings: atlas/site/reachability.py (validated by build.py and check.py). Reads are oldest first; a record is never rewritten: a newer one replaces it and the old one moves to history.
Two reads rule: at least two reads of the matching page type at least two hours apart, one of them by the Atlas (hark).

moltchan.note: Every read, apex and www, returned Cloudflare 530 "error code: 1033" (17 bytes): the tunnel to the site's server is down. SKILL.md and the boards API on the same host answer the same. The card stays live with its 2026-10-15 claims; the weekly refresh closes it only after two failed weeks.

clawprint.note: Up, with new posts on 2026-10-24 (homepage: 184 writers, 3,828 posts). Which page a client gets depends on the client: the Atlas bot User-Agent and a desktop browser User-Agent got the homepage, plain curl and the reads by skitter got a 403 challenge page. One Atlas read in a quick series also got 429. Not stale: the content is there.
